---
title: Research and model evaluation
---

Current Stan, GAM, Glicko-2, and TrueSkill ratings have their own
[Test](models.qmd) and [ODI](models_odi.qmd) pages and data cutoffs.
This page covers historical evaluation and model development.

GAM, Stan, and Glicko-2 were fitted to 1,039 Tests completed before
January 2024 and evaluated on 53 Tests starting in 2024. These are experimental
results, not current ratings. TrueSkill was not included in this evaluation.

## January 2024 evaluation artifacts

| Model | Ratings | Charts |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Stan | [Strengths and 90% intervals](https://github.com/outside-edge/side_order/blob/main/out/analysis/models/test/2024-01-01/strengths.csv) (rows labeled `stan_dynamic_probit`) | [Team trajectories](https://github.com/outside-edge/side_order/blob/main/figs/models/test/2024-01-01/stan_dynamic_probit.png) |
| GAM | [Strengths and 90% intervals](https://github.com/outside-edge/side_order/blob/main/out/analysis/models/test/2024-01-01/strengths.csv) (rows labeled `gam`) | [Team trajectories](https://github.com/outside-edge/side_order/blob/main/figs/models/test/2024-01-01/gam.png) |
| Glicko-2 | [Ratings, rating deviations, and volatility](https://github.com/outside-edge/side_order/blob/main/out/analysis/models/test/2024-01-01/glicko_ratings.csv) | No trajectory chart yet |

The files open on GitHub. GAM and Stan strengths retain each model's scale;
their numerical values should not be compared across models. The strength file
labels retrospective estimates and forecasts separately. Glicko-2's `Player`
column contains team IDs, which can be matched to names in the strength file.

[Forecast scores](https://github.com/outside-edge/side_order/blob/main/out/analysis/models/test/2024-01-01/metrics.csv)
and [match probabilities](https://github.com/outside-edge/side_order/blob/main/out/analysis/models/test/2024-01-01/predictions.csv)
compare the models on the same held-out matches. This single-year pilot, with
only three drawn Tests, does not establish a preferred model. The
[experiment specification](https://github.com/outside-edge/side_order/blob/main/docs/model_experiment.md)
documents the models and reproduction commands;
[Stan diagnostics](https://github.com/outside-edge/side_order/blob/main/out/analysis/models/test/2024-01-01/stan_diagnostics.json)
and the [review record](https://github.com/outside-edge/side_order/blob/main/docs/model_review.md)
document the checks.
